title: Type filter is single-select, first in the filter row, with options Both, Inventory, Catalogue (default Both)
permissions_required: Manager or Office User role (Reports section access) plus the Inventory Reports → View permission (S1-R4).
preconditions: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
2. This is a first visit (no saved view), so the first-visit defaults apply.
steps: 1. Look at the first control in the filter row of the toolbar.
2. Open the Type filter and read its options.
3. Note which option is selected by default.
expected: 1. The Type filter is the first control in the filter row.
2. It is single-select and offers exactly: Both, Inventory, Catalogue.
3. On a first visit the default is Both.
4. Both is an explicit selection returning inventory and catalogue rows together - a deliberate filter value, not the absence of a filter.
